author: Play On Tabletop
description:
One of our favourite Warhammer 40,000 events (and more) is the Las Vegas Open. We will be there! Will you? https://www.lasvegasopen.net/ This video sponsored by Frontline Gaming.

Both the Grey Knights and T'au bring dynamic armies that blur the concept of a frontline.  Michael looks to pilot his Grey Knights to victory over a Nick that is over the moon with T'au in the current edition.  It's another Warhammer 40,000 11th edition matchup!
